hero.pill: Requirements management for projects where every decision must leave a trail
hero.headline: Requirements truly organized. Not just documented.
hero.subtitle: Built for teams where poorly defined scope turns into costly rework. Structured requirements, mapped dependencies, traceable validations.
highlights: Fewer meetings to decide what was already decided
Each area knows what impacts its own work
Export the way the client needs to see it

panel.title: What a PM needs and what a stakeholder can actually read.

items.title: Organized requirements
items.text: Every field exists for a reason. Nothing loose.

items.title: Auditable decisions
items.text: When someone asks 'who approved this?', the answer is already there.

items.title: Cross-area view
items.text: What impacts Billing when Contracts change. Visible before it becomes a problem.

features.title: Three points where projects usually stall
features.subtitle: Each module was designed from real problems in scope gathering.

items.title: 5W2H Requirements
items.description: Every requirement needs an owner, a reason and a date. 5W2H puts that into structure before scope becomes hallway talk.

items.title: Cross Matrix
items.description: Does one module depend on another? Does the integration affect billing? The matrix shows it while there's still time to act.

items.title: Real-time Collaboration
items.description: Comments, status and decision history in the same place. No more digging through an email from three weeks ago.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. No guesswork in between.
howItWorks.subtitle: What comes in structured, goes out structured. Without losing rigor along the way.

steps.title: Structure the scope
steps.description: Every requirement with who decided, why it was decided that way, and what changes if the scope shifts.

steps.title: Connect the impacts
steps.description: Before someone is caught off guard in a validation meeting, you already know where the conflict is.

steps.title: Validate with clarity
steps.description: Generate the validation material straight from the platform. What the client sees is what's at the source.

footer.tagline: For projects where a poorly documented decision costs dearly.
